text:
harry (SRE): Quick pitch: run a 10-business-day 'closure ledger' for postmortems but with a twist — introduce a rotating 'followup steward' (2-week handoff) who owns stale reviews and escalation coordination. Goal: reduce open-age and surface repeat buckets faster.

meera: sounds interesting. steward = different from IC?

harry (SRE): Yes. IC runs the incident. Steward owns the postmortem follow-through lifecycle until actions close or handoff to product/infra. Steward rotation is 2 weeks (overlaps with IC rotation).

tony: ok, what does the tracker look like in practice? keep it tiny pls.

harry (SRE): Minimal CSV row: ```id, owner, steward, svc, bucket, priority(P0/P1/P2), due_date, status(triage|in-progress|blocked|verify|closed), verify_note, dash_link, rc_cat, recurrence_tag``` Owner + due_date required. steward auto-filled by rotation.

claire: add an "age_bucket" column (0-7d, 8-14d, 15-30d, 30+d) so dashboards can show aging and trigger policies.

meera: policy suggestions?

harry (SRE): propose age-based actions: 8-14d -> steward nudges + DM; 15-30d -> steward escalates to oncall lead; >30d -> steward creates a short remediation review meeting and flags for leadership. Also add stale transition at 14d which auto-assigns a rotating reviewer if no activity.

followup-bot: automated message: "Reminder: 4 follow-through actions >7d. Run /followup-list to view."

ton y: how do we detect recurring patterns?

harry (SRE): tag each row svc+bucket+rc_cat. Weekly rollup: GROUP BY svc,bucket,rc_cat in last 30d. If count>1 -> assign "recurrence_flag". If same flag appears twice in 60d, schedule a deeper RCA workshop.

claire: verification is the choke point. keep it light: require 1-3 bullet smoke steps + one-line outcome + dashboard link. No heavy docs to close.

meera: IC rotation change? currently monthly — do we keep that?

harry (SRE): keep monthly IC if you prefer but steward rotation is shorter (2w) and overlaps with IC handoffs. That keeps follow-up ownership continuous without changing oncall cadence.

ton y: automation?

harry (SRE): ops-bot will: 1) label incidents 'closure-ledger' when PM posts, 2) DM owners at 48h and 7d, 3) post age-bucket summary weekly, 4) transition to stale at 14d and assign reviewer from steward pool.

followup-bot: automated: "Label 'closure-ledger' applied to incidents 8245, 8249."

claire: pilot plan?

harry (SRE): run pilot on next two Sev1/Sev2 incidents that hit oncall (IDs: 8245, 8249). Meera will steward, Tony will host the first weekly 30m sync. Metrics to capture: median time-to-verify, #stale_transitions, recurrence_flags, open-age histogram.

meera: i'll run it, start next Monday and share a 1-pager after both windows close.

harry (SRE): I'll add a tracker CSV template + invite blurb and post in #eng-oncall tomorrow. If pilot looks good, we ship a tiny repo with template + ops-bot scripts. Keep it low friction.

tony: one ask: bot nudges should be DM-only. summary posts okay in thread.

harry (SRE): agreed. thanks all."
